blocks.label: Hero
blocks.description: The opening statement of a page: a large heading, a line of text, the main buttons. Use first, once.

blocks.label: Hero with screenshot
blocks.description: The opening statement beside a product screenshot. The home page's first section.

blocks.label: Hero with form
blocks.description: The opening statement beside a lead form from the forms collection (the two-step demo request by default), for pages whose only job is to start a conversation.

blocks.label: Logo row
blocks.description: Customer or partner logos, in a quiet row under a hero or as a grid of tiles.

blocks.label: Metrics
blocks.description: Two to four figures that prove a claim, with an optional source note.

blocks.label: Testimonial
blocks.description: One quotation, set large, with the person and their company. Once per page.

blocks.label: Testimonials
blocks.description: Several shorter quotes in a grid of cards.

blocks.label: Case studies
blocks.description: Cards from the customer stories, newest first or chosen by name, optionally one industry only.

blocks.label: Awards and ratings
blocks.description: A row of badges or ratings. Keep every claim true and checkable.

blocks.label: Feature grid
blocks.description: Short points with icons, two to four columns: benefits, capabilities, principles.

blocks.label: Feature with screenshot
blocks.description: One capability beside its screenshot. Alternate the side when several run in a row.

blocks.label: Feature tabs
blocks.description: Several product areas, one shown at a time, each with a screenshot.

blocks.label: Steps
blocks.description: How it works, in order: along a row, or down a timeline with a label per step.

blocks.label: Integrations
blocks.description: What the product connects to, as tiles grouped by category.

blocks.label: Comparison table
blocks.description: You against the alternatives, row by row, with ticks, dashes or short text.

blocks.label: Use cases
blocks.description: Cards that send each kind of visitor to the page written for them.

blocks.label: Screenshot
blocks.description: One large, framed product picture with a caption and numbered notes.

blocks.label: Pricing plans
blocks.description: Plans side by side, one of them featured.

blocks.label: Plan comparison
blocks.description: Every plan's features, group by group, under the pricing plans.

blocks.label: FAQ
blocks.description: Questions and answers that open one at a time.

blocks.label: Rich text
blocks.description: A passage of formatted text: a story, a policy, small print.

blocks.label: Latest posts
blocks.description: The newest blog posts, optionally one tag only.

blocks.label: Latest updates
blocks.description: The newest product updates from the changelog.

blocks.label: Team
blocks.description: People from the team collection, chosen by name or everyone in order.

blocks.label: Security
blocks.description: How customers' data is protected: practices with icons and reassurance chips.

blocks.label: Call to action
blocks.description: The closing invitation, as a band or an inset panel. Last on most pages.

blocks.label: Contact
blocks.description: Ways to reach you beside a form from the forms collection (the contact form by default). The contact page's main section.

blocks.label: Newsletter
blocks.description: A one-line email sign-up, beside its heading or under it, using the newsletter form.

blocks.label: Form
blocks.description: Any form from the forms collection, with a heading above it or beside it — drop a demo request, a sign-up or a survey onto any page.

templates.label: Landing page
templates.description: A campaign page: hero with screenshot, logos, benefits, proof and one call to action.

templates.label: Product page
templates.description: One product area: a statement, three features with screenshots, metrics, a quote and a call to action.

templates.label: Solution page
templates.description: For one industry or team: their problem, what changes, proof from someone like them and an FAQ.

templates.label: Pricing page
templates.description: Plans, the full comparison, ratings and the questions buyers ask about price.

templates.label: Customer story
templates.description: A case study: the customer, the problem, what they did and the results in numbers.

templates.label: About page
templates.description: The company's story, figures, leadership and values.

templates.label: Contact page
templates.description: A contact form beside the ways to reach you, and a newsletter sign-up.
